scope: Final Stage-2 authority and pinned GPyTorch README/package metadata were inspected statically; general Gaussian-process capabilities, environment, installation, license and Atlas relationship remain source-scoped.

unresolved_findings.finding: Core requirements use minimum/range constraints and scikit-learn is unversioned; no fully immutable transitive environment is established.
Optional dev/docs/examples/KeOps/Pyro/test groups have heterogeneous version constraints and were not normalized into one environment.
GPU acceleration and scalable GP inference claims remain documentation-scoped; no scientific workload was executed.
Repository examples/tutorials remain library documentation and are not promoted to standalone Stage-3 experiments.
Bundled example/test archives and model assets remain support material rather than a standalone PINN research dataset.

notes: GPyTorch is supporting Gaussian-process infrastructure, not a PINN implementation.
